sponsor_or_proposer: National Oil Corp (NOC) and General Electricity Company of Libya (GECOL)
current_state: Pre-concept. On 16 Sep 2025 NOC chairman Masoud Suleiman and GECOL met and 'explored the possibility of establishing platforms for supplying liquefied gas to the plants to avoid unit shutdowns, as well as building additional fuel storage tanks.' No site, no named developer, no capacity, no FSRU named, no FID/FEED/MOU/tender — the parties only 'agreed to strengthen cooperation' (and to form a joint technical committee). It is ambiguous whether 'liquefied gas' means LNG regasification or LPG; the Libya country note flags that recent Brega activity is LPG/gas-distribution, not LNG.
missing_threshold_elements: sponsor (only NOC/GECOL as conveners, no terminal developer/SPV); location (no site named); concrete step (only an exploratory discussion, no MOU/FEED/permit/site selection); also unclear if LNG vs LPG.
watch_for: A named import/regas site or FSRU charter; an NOC or GECOL tender or MOU for LNG/FSRU supply to a specific power plant (e.g. Tobruk, ~740 MW, 150–165 MMcfd); any FSRU operator (Karpowership/Kinetics, Excelerate, Höegh Evi) reporting a Libya deployment. Re-check ~2026-12 to 2027-06.
notes: Three independent non-GEM sources, all url_verifier PASS on tokens 'GECOL' and 'liquefied': (1) NOC official press release (noc.ly) — the primary source, NOC chairman hosts extended technical meeting with GECOL general manager; (2) The Libya Observer (libyaobserver.ly), dated Tue 16/09/2025, byline AbdulkaderAssad; (3) LibyaReview (libyareview.com). No gem.wiki/globalenergymonitor.org citation used. Meeting concept: platforms for supplying liquefied gas to power plants plus additional fuel storage tanks; joint technical committee to be formed. NOT a Marsa El Brega revival — this is an import/gas-to-power supply concept, distinct from the existing GEM export terminal. researcher_initials: AI-draft (discovery sweep).
